payload.purpose_context: On a fresh clone the status board refuses with a raw unreadable-ref error and the recovery text claims the branch was never fetched while omitting the step that actually unblocks reads. This Mission makes every remote-only refusal carry one canonical, truthful remedy naming the right remote.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give operators on a fresh clone a complete, truthful recovery path when a Mission's coordination or topic branch exists only on a remote.

payload.question: Are the operator rulings of 2026-11-20 for #5287 (typed remote-only refusal at the status read door with no remote-tracking read source; #5936 and #7449 out of scope; one canonical remedy using the resolved remote; MISSION_BRANCH_REF gets the same refusal) the binding scope?

payload.final_answer: Yes, binding as stated (operator rulings 2026-11-20, relayed by the orchestrator; Phase 2 design debrief sent, no new ruling required)
